_comment: Per-file line coverage thresholds (%). Files not listed default to 'default'.
_comment_tooling: tools/library-panic-audit/* and tools/api-dump/src/main.rs: release llvm-cov cannot attribute the audit binary's CLI and parsing/error surface (exercised by scripts/test-audit-library-panics.py subprocess fixtures) or convenience binaries without a test contract. audit.rs pinned at 49: 49.9% release coverage of production lines only, measured after its inline tests moved to src/audit/tests/ (#953, #960); the earlier ~61% also counted the inline test module's own lines. main.rs at 0. Remove when the self-test suite runs in-process under llvm-cov.
_comment_capi: crates/tensor4all-capi/{hdf5,simplett,tensorci,types}.rs: C API binding surfaces whose release coverage is below default because the FFI helpers/constructors are exercised by the capi test suite and by Tensor4all.jl integration tests outside this repository, which llvm-cov cannot see; thresholds record measured release percentages (0/40/55/69). Remove per file when its in-repo tests reach the default.
_comment_expensive_algorithms: crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/{treetn/fit,operator/mod}.rs: expensive fitting paths are covered by focused integration tests (treetn tests/fit_*.rs, itensorlike examples/test_gmres_*, capi quanticstransform tests) rather than the default unit suite; release llvm-cov misses the heavier sweeps. Thresholds record measured percentages (66/0). Remove per file when release-mode path tests bring it to the default.
_comment_reference_crates: crates/tensor4all-core/src/tensor_index.rs, crates/mdarray-einsum/src/typed_tensor.rs, crates/tensor4all-itensorlike/src/linsolve.rs: legacy/reference surfaces whose release coverage reflects integration-test exercise (tensor_index via contract tests, typed_tensor via mdarray-einsum tests, itensorlike linsolve via tests/linsolve.rs). Thresholds record measured values (0/45/0). Remove when dedicated unit tests reach the default.
_comment_boundary_modules: crates/tensor4all-tensorbackend/src/storage.rs (72) and crates/tensor4all-hdf5/src/compat.rs (62): internals partially exercised only through higher-level consumers in the workspace nextest run and crates/tensor4all-hdf5/tests/test_hdf5.rs (which runs under cargo test, excluded from nextest). Remove when dedicated unit tests cover the internal paths.
_comment_dmrg_release_only: crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/dmrg/mod.rs: release-only deficit — debug measures 77.2% (debug_assert paths compiled out in release), release 72.4%; DMRG sweep paths are exercised by tests/tdvp.rs and the dmrg/gse integration tests. Pinned at 72. Remove when release-mode path tests bring it to the default.
_comment_coverage_machine_variance: crates/tensor4all-partitionedtreetn/src/adaptive_interpolation/options.rs (73), crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/tdvp/mod.rs (74), crates/tensor4all-tensorbackend/src/lib.rs (71) and crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/gse.rs (74): every one of these sits on the 75% boundary and measures on both sides of it, so which of them land under the default depends on the runner (the hosted runner reports the first two, a local release run the last two). Pinned at the lower observation; the same reason the tutorial-code entry above records. Remove when dedicated unit tests clear the boundary.
_comment_split_inline_tests: crates/tensor4all-tensorbackend/src/lib.rs (71) and crates/tensor4all-treetn/src/gse.rs (74): moving their inline #[cfg(test)] modules out (#953) removed the test module's own lines from those files' denominators, so release coverage now measures the production lines only (71.4% and 74.2%). Pinned at the measured floor; remove when dedicated unit tests reach the default.
_comment_hdf5: crates/tensor4all-hdf5/src/compat.rs (62): HDF5 I/O internals are exercised by crates/tensor4all-hdf5/tests/test_hdf5.rs under `cargo test` (dlopen-based tests cannot run under nextest or llvm-cov); release llvm-cov cannot attribute them. Remove when the HDF5 suite runs under a coverage-compatible harness.
_comment_tutorial_code: docs/tutorial-code/src/qtt_interval_common.rs: shared helper for the tutorial binaries; release coverage is CI-variant (74.4% on the hosted runner, >=75 locally) because the long-running tutorial binaries (docs/tutorial-code/src/bin/*) exercise different path sets per run. The tutorials themselves are the deterministic artifact; pinned at 74. Remove when tutorial-code gains a stable unit suite.
